questions.q: Which cloud type looks like cotton candy and can have a trailing tail?
questions.why: Cirrus clouds resemble cotton candy and may have a tail.

questions.q: What does a longer tail on a cirrus cloud indicate?
questions.why: A longer tail on cirrus clouds signals stronger wind.

questions.q: Which wind type moves the high‑altitude cirrus clouds?
questions.why: The ground wind is described as moving cirrus clouds at high altitude.

questions.q: Which animal behavior is linked to windy conditions?
questions.why: Spiders start to spin smaller webs when it's windy.

questions.q: What does a bird flying high suggest about upcoming weather?
questions.why: Birds flying high indicate a storm may be approaching.
